meta.title: The Integrated Plan
meta.subtitle: Bar muscle-up · tendon feats · kettlebell · sprint & hinge
meta.overrideRule: If a session is compromised, the muscle-up work is done in full and the tendon work is cut. Never the reverse.

rules.action: Hold the current load another full week. No progression. Keep the volume.

rules.test: maxPain > 5 OR stiffness == over60 OR pain rising 3 sessions running
rules.action: Cut load 30%. Swap dynamic work for isometrics (5 × 45 s pain-free) for 7 days. Unchanged after two weeks — get it assessed.

trafficLight.elbowRule: Any amber on the medial elbow holds the weighted pull-up load where it is, regardless of the schedule. That tendon is the one thing that can end the muscle-up attempt.

checkpoints.label: P1 test
checkpoints.detail: 8 clean parallel dips + 5 strict chest-to-bar pulls

checkpoints.label: P2 test + RECALIBRATE
checkpoints.detail: 5 s straight-bar negative + 4 Russian dips. Then retest pull-up 5RM — all Block 3 loads key off the new number.

checkpoints.label: P3 test + RECALIBRATE
checkpoints.detail: 1 clean single with the light band + 5 straight-bar dips. Then retest pull-up 5RM.

checkpoints.label: TENDON TEST
checkpoints.detail: Heel raise +35% BW × 8, then 20 continuous single-leg pogos. Film the pogos.

checkpoints.label: NORDIC TEST
checkpoints.detail: Weighted Nordic at 5 kg, full range with push-back.

checkpoints.label: MUSCLE-UP TEST
checkpoints.detail: 1 strict unassisted rep. Backup Thu 31 Dec.

exercises.name: Weighted chest-to-bar pull-up
exercises.cue: Dead hang start, touch lower sternum, zero swing.

exercises.name: Parallel bar dips (band or BW)
exercises.cue: Lower until shoulders break 90°, then lock out. Lean forward 15°, elbows tucked.

exercises.name: Straight-bar support hold
exercises.cue: Jump on, lock elbows, push shoulders down into depression.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.cue: Lower back glued flat to the floor, ribs tucked toward pelvis.

exercises.name: Sprints, 30 m
exercises.cue: After the full warm-up. Grass or track. Stop the session if form degrades.

exercises.name: Trap-bar deadlift (or back squat)
exercises.cue: Your acceleration and static-jump driver.

exercises.name: Double-leg heel raise off step
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, full plantarflexion at the top. Superset with the KB press.

exercises.name: KB single-arm strict press
exercises.cue: Ribs down, glutes tight, no lean. Alternate with the heel raise sets.

exercises.name: KB single-arm floor press
exercises.cue: Elbow at 45°, pause with the triceps on the floor.

exercises.name: Parallel bar 3-second dip negatives
exercises.cue: Jump to top, lower agonisingly slow over 3 full seconds. Fight hardest at the bottom.

exercises.cue: Overhand. Chin clearly over bar, full elbow lockout at the bottom.

exercises.name: Scapular dip shrugs
exercises.cue: In dip support: shrug to ears, then press tall.

exercises.name: Band face pulls + external rotation
exercises.cue: Pull to eye level, thumbs pointing backward.
